The girl remains focused on the camera with a joyful smile while the man maintains a playful, supportive demeanor. The camera remains static at a medium shot distance. (5) The girl playfully pushes the man away after he makes a comical facial expression. She continues the dance solo for a few seconds before he returns to the center to finish the routine with synchronized clapping and waving. (6) The girl and man conclude the performance and walk out of the frame in opposite directions. The setting remains consistent with high-key, warm lighting throughout the entire sequence.
